installPackages.name: Overflight
installPackages.description:
Provides Apple TV's Aerials screen savers as video wallpapers for Projectivy Launcher.
You can also customize the URL to the JSON file that lists media items, which means you can use this plugin to provide Projectivy with any video (or picture) list you want (trailers, live cams, etc.).

installPackages.name: Daily Photos
installPackages.description: "Photo of the Day" as wallpaper for Projectivy Launcher.

installPackages.name: Aerial Views
installPackages.description: The popular Android TV screensaver can also act as a Wallpaper Provider for Projectivy, offering many high-quality videos from different sources.

installPackages.name: Weather Wallpaper for Projectivy
installPackages.description: A wallpaper provider plugin that turns your Projectivy Launcher home screen into a weather display. Current conditions, optional forecast panels, and backgrounds that react to the weather. Weather data from Open-Meteo. No API key, no account, no tracking.

installPackages.name: Sofadrop
installPackages.description: Sofadrop turns your home screen into a rotating showcase of movies and TV shows from the lists you choose: what's trending, your Trakt or Simkl lists, any public Trakt or MDBList list… Everything is generated on your TV and set up from inside the launcher, with a live preview.

installPackages.name: Immich Wallpaper for Projectivy
installPackages.description: Shows photos from your self-hosted Immich server as the launcher wallpaper on Android TV / Fire TV (FireOS 7.x, Android 9, 32-bit userspace).

installPackages.name: Movie Art for Projectivy
installPackages.description: A wallpaper plugin for the Projectivy AndroidTV launcher which fetches movie and TV show backgrounds from TheMovieDB.org.

installPackages.name: Trakt Wallpapers for Projectivy
installPackages.description: This wallpaper authenticates with Trakt and fetches backdrop and logo artwork from TMDB, rendering wallpapers locally.

installPackages.name: Core Motion
installPackages.description: Serves motion feed and bundled loops to Projectivy Premium as launcher wallpapers

installPackages.name: Booru Wallpaper Provider
installPackages.description: This is a Projectivy Plugin that allows you to set a wallpaper from a Booru imageboard.

installPackages.name: Projectivy Icon Pack
installPackages.description: The Projectivy Icon Pack is designed specifically for Projectivy Launcher. It now includes over 800 icons.

installPackages.name: Android Tv Minimalist Icon Pack
installPackages.description: Minimalist Icon Pack's goal is to provide a clean "icon-first" look, but instead with a unifying background color similar to SicMundus86's work. The icon pack prioritizes non-text symbols, using wordmarks only when unavoidable.

installPackages.name: Core Builds Icon Pack
installPackages.description: Icons are original geometry drawn on a shared 512 grid — simple shapes, rounded ends, one accent colour per app — not traced vendor logos. Backgrounds are fully transparent, so the launcher's own card colour shows through. It now includes over 900 icons.

installPackages.name: Arcticons Day&Night
installPackages.description: With over 15000 icons, Arcticons is one of the largest free & open source icon-packs available, featuring consistent and elegant handcrafted icons. Built for phones (1:1 ratio), it's nonetheless compatible with Projectivy Launcher.
